$comment: What the rules say about this article TODAY, as data rather than as a sentence in a docblock.
It is not a target and not a clean bill of health — the fixture's README says findings here
are measurements. Its job is the SILENCE half: a rule that starts reporting something new on
225 lines of real prose has almost certainly gained a false positive, and the harness beside
this file names the rule. That is not expressible on an eleven-line stub, where every line was
written by someone who already knew which rule would read it.
Recorded 2026-09-19. Three of the five are about the scorecard being deliberately thin
(no pdf, no frozen source) rather than about the prose; paper/typography's single entry is
the 18 p-values of rpp#44, and it is expected to DROP to zero when that is fixed — a drop is
never a failure here, only growth is.
